A 1kHz and 3kHz tone can be selected with the DIFFICULTY SWITCHES, and the patterns can be selected by scrolling forward or backwards through the list via the GAME SELECT or GAME RESET console switches.

210942.overview:
Ask anyone what games they played on their Atari 2600 when they were younger, and invariably Combat will be included among the titles listed. For many years, Combat was the pack-in game that came with every Atari 2600 sold, and even today it's tough to avoid stumbling among Combat cartridges when you're looking for 2600 games. The premise in Combat is fairly simple. You and a friend battle one another in tanks, bi-planes and jet-fighters to see who can score the most points in a fixed amount of time.

The original version of Combat supports many game variations, but few unique playfields. Zach Matley has created a new version of Combat, dubbed Combat Redux, that allows for 28 unique playfields. This new version of Combat supports seven groups of four playfields each: seven open mazes, seven easy mazes, seven complex mazes, and seven cloud designs. The first three groups are for tank games, and the last group is for jet-fighter and bi-plane games.

422726.overview: This is a video game where you must guide a snail through an adventure, encountering both friendly and hostile animals along the way, to help it reach its goal.

440152.overview:
Welcome to CIRCUS CONVOY, the first Atari 2600 game brought to you by David Crane and Garry Kitchen in almost 30 years!

In CIRCUS CONVOY, you play as Andre the Magnificent, A.K.A "The Chameleon", a circus strongman traveling in The Heartland Traveling Circus.

As the circus convoy barrels down the blacktop, Andre has learned that a rival circus has sabotaged their gear, all but guaranteeing cancellation of their next show! In the process, the saboteur has scattered an array of Circus Props throughout the convoy for you to use. But be careful! Many dangerous items were also left behind.

Now it's up to you and Andre to collect every Circus Prop and check out all the Sideshows to make sure every target and skill work perfectly. Good luck!

457160.overview:
Howdy partners!  I hear that GOLD has been found up them thar hills and conductor Casey O’Kelly and his iron horse have been put in charge of gettin’ it all safely across the desert!  But word is some varmints are plannin’ to rob the train.  Well, butter my butt and call me a biscuit, ain’t that something!

As righteous folk, we don’t have a hankering to leave ol’ Casey playing a lone hand on this one, so you best get a wiggle on and catch the Gold Rush Gulch Railroad for a world-renowned designer Dan Kitchen.

That thar train has been overrun with desert critters, bodie ghosts and all sorts of excuse me ma’ams, so it ain’t gonna be easy.  So ya best be smart and help Casey protect the gold.  Hopefully you’ll be happifying yourself to some point and maybe even eventuating one of those fine as cream gravy collectible patches.

And always remember, don’t squat with your spurs on!

464988.overview:
Philip Blackman brings an all-new version of the burger-building arcade classic home to the Atari 2600! You’re Pete the Chef, living your worst nightmare as chaos reigns all around you - forced to make gigantic hamburgers while living foodstuffs have decided to

put you on their menu! Can you keep up the pace, or will they have it their way? 


Chaotic Grill features all of the enemies and levels from the arcade game, arcade-quality graphics and sounds, and SaveKey/AtariVox support for saving high scores!

467096.overview: A prototype of a 2600 port of Choplifter. The game is only about 50% complete and is, unfortunately, not playable in its current state. It's unknown if Atari further developed the game, or if this is was the final version that was made.

467362.overview:
In 1993, ten years after lightning birthed Dark Code, an AI that pulled Uncle Victor into cyberspace, it's back, corrupting data to escape into reality. Victor must return and stop it. This is Cyber Run: Low Tech.

The game Cyber Run – Low Tech is a title for the Atari 2600, developed for K.R.A.Z. Production.

467363.overview:
"Caramujo Light" is a version of the officially released "Caramujo" video game designed for Atari 2600.

"Caramujo Light" is a simplified version, and unlike the original game, the simplifications are as follows:

-Jumping over bees is slightly easier.

-The level structures of levels 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9 have been slightly simplified. Adjustments have been made to the key's position, bee movement, and platform expansion.

-The game now includes the ability to continue twice during gameplay. This allows players to resume from the beginning of the current chapter. The first chapter consists of levels 1-4 and does not include the continue option since level 1 is the start of the chapter. The second chapter consists of level 5. The third chapter includes levels 6-8. The fourth chapter includes level 9. The fifth chapter includes level 10, after which the game concludes with a fitting animation.

467374.overview:
You are the last guardian of the galaxy. Armed with a powerful laser cannon, your mission is to destroy alien intruders and keep the universe safe and clean.

In Cosmic Custodian, the rules are simple yet challenging. Your mission is to destroy alien enemies that fire at you.

467422.overview: Another cave to explore!  Cave Raider is a large, 64k update to Cave Run with many enhancements. This time, you’re on a mission for fame, fortune, and untold riches. You’ve heard rumors that this ancient cave has over 100 treasures ripe for the taking, but it’s a dangerous path that must be taken in order to find them all. An ancient map has charted about half of the cave, and previous explorers have named the rooms, but none have tried to escape with the treasures. There are falling rocks, bats, traps, dangerous platforms, and numerous obstacles in your way. Are you up for the challenge?

467423.overview: Join Jinny, an adorable Cat Girl Maid on her quest to defeat the evil Carrot King in a HUGE side scrolling adventure for your Atari 2600 VCS! Run, Jump, and Throw yarn balls through huge multi-colour levels, all while defeating challenging and complex bosses! Jinny puts the "Purr" in Purrfect Adventure!

468009.overview:
The purpose of the game is to successfully traverse all nine rooms of the castle. These rooms can be accessed through their doors in the main hall. The eight rooms on the main hall’s lower floors are accessible from the beginning. After having completed these eight rooms, the ninth room, located on the top floor, will become accessible. Each room of the castle is completed by first locating and operating the black lever that opens the exit door. Next, the player must reach and go through the open exit door. Once a room has been completed, it cannot be accessed anymore. After all nine rooms of the castle have been completed, the game ends. Each room contains a unique set of traps and obstacles. When entering a room, it can be useful to “study” it for finding the easiest way to the black lever, and to the exit door. Upon colliding with a monster or falling out of a room, the player is returned to the main hall. The number of attempts per game (“lives”) is unlimited.

The player moves horizontally on a platform by pressing LEFT and RIGHT. Climbing up a platform is done by pressing UP while touching that platform. Climbing down from a platform is possible only by falling off it (there is no fall damage). Pressing FIRE triggers an instant short-distance leap in the direction the player is facing. This is necessary to bridge gaps and to avoid colliding with stationary or oncoming monsters. Some rooms require precise leaping in order to not fall out of the room. Any interaction with objects (elevators, black levers, collectibles etc.) is done by touching them.

Summary: movement - LEFT / RIGHT / UP, instant leap - FIRE

468012.overview: Directions: you are The Cheat.  Bubs (the orange guy) in the concession stand wants 12 Cheatcakes (little yellow boxes).  You can only carry 4 at a time.  Find them and bring them back to him.  Don't get caught by strongbad (red guy) or he will steal your cakes and send you back to your house.  If you fall in a pit, use the joystick button to levitate out.  Also watch out for grumblecakes (black boxes) as too many of those are bad for you.

471272.overview:
The alien threat has returned, more aggressive than ever. As the last guardian of the galaxy, you must purge the sector of these relentless intruders and restore order with your trusty laser cannon.


This game uses the DPC+ bankswitching technique.

471284.overview:
Terror reigns in The Old Kingdom. An evil sorcerer is ruling the land. Then one day, he is challenged by a barbarian Knight who is traveling from a foreign land to seek fame and fortune. You take control of the brave knight as you decide the fate of the Kingdom in this all-new Atari 2600 game.

Fight your way through the forest and conquer the three castles he occupies to overthrow the evil sorcerer and become the new king.

471426.overview:
A hack of Bowling.

Have you ever bowled on a cosmic bowling night? Everyone dresses up, the lights are turned off, and the lanes light up. Excitement mounts as the pins begin to glow in the dark. Scott Dayton has put a new twist on the original Atari Bowling to give the feel of a real cosmic bowling night. If you consider yourself to be a bowler at heart, or just love a casual game of bowling, this hack is not one to be passed up!

471452.overview: Combat Rock was an interesting experiment by Paul Slocum (creator of the Synthcart) to see if he could add background music to an existing 2600 game. His first victim was Atari's Combat! While you play the game, you're treated to a rendition of "Rock the Casbah" by the Clash.

471457.overview:
Cannonhead Clash is a two player bomb-lobbing game featuring two things, known as Cannonheads, chucking bombs at each other. The object of the game is to hit the other Cannonhead with a bomb, causing them to fall into the water below. The bombs can also be used to destroy the terrain! Use this to your advantage, and try not to let your side get destroyed too much--you can't jump, and you can't climb up walls more than one block high!

To move your Cannonhead, all you need to do is hold left or right on the joystick. The fire button allows you to shoot your bomb. Remember, the longer you hold down the fire button before releasing it, the farther your bomb will go! Strategy and quick thinking are key--may the best Cannonhead win!

471718.overview: A homebrew port of the game Choplifter!

473495.overview:
In a distant human colony called Sagan202, aliens made a surprise attack. They destroyed several cities and the survivors took refuge in a huge cave in the hope that something or someone will come to save them as soon as possible as the aliens are approaching and they have not come in peace.

Objective: 
Your mission is to find and rescue the six survivors who are hiding in this huge cave, to find them you must explore well the five regions, when you find the first survivor you must take him to the mothership that is at the beginning of his journey, when touching it with the survivor on board will be made the rescue, soon after you must repeat the process until the six survivors are rescued.

You'll notice that your ship only supports one person at a time, so it's recommended that when you find a survivor, you immediately return to the mothership before setting out in search of another.

Don't be alarmed if you don't find the survivor in the place where you had found him in a previous match, because every time the game is restarted, a random version of his position is set.

In this mission you must pay attention to 3 things: your fuel, the walls and the aliens. When the ship shoots or moves from one area to another, it loses some fuel, in case it runs out, the ship will crash into the ground and will be destroyed, it will also be destroyed when it collides with the walls of the cave or when it is attacked by the aliens. If the ship is destroyed and the player has one or more extra lives, the ship appears near the beginning of the game or near the last activated checkpoint, with one extra life less.

Game modes:
To select the desired game mode, you must set the "Difficulty Left" switch on A to play in hard mode or on B to play normal mode.

*Normal mode:
In this mode there are extra lives, two checkpoints, at the beginning the enemies move slowly and there are barriers that prevent the player from getting too far away from the next survivor.

*Hard mode:
In this mode there are no extra lives, just a checkpoint, the enemies are fast and there are no barriers, which will make the player get lost more easily.

Alien species:
*Blocker: A kind of passive alien, who does not seek to attack directly and his intention is to block the passages.
*Stalker: A blind but highly aggressive species, it attacks fiercely when it notices the presence of an enemy.
*Teleporter: Smarter species, in an inexplicable way he manages to teleport. Just like the ship, he seeks to find the survivors to eliminate them.

Cave: 
Your adventure will take place in a huge cave in the basement of a human colony, this cave is divided into 5 regions which are:
*Dracon: Humid, covered by moss, the result of an experiment that sought to expand the vegetation on the site.
*Gaegos: Dry and rocky, very similar to the arid caves of our home planet.
*Reador: Extremely hot, with magma running down its walls, its average temperature is 80° degrees centigrade.

474155.overview:
Stanley fell in love with Alina on a dating website. He promised to marry her before learning her secret: she has an angry conjoined twin sister, Alisa. Stanley must separate the two if his relationship with Alina is to have a chance.

You play Stanley. You must catch the hearts Alina is throwing to you while avoiding the broken hearts and daggers Alisa is throwing at you. With a little skill, you might just make it to the operation!
